name: Smite Evil
description: Strike with holy power against evil foes.

name: Dispel Magic
description: Remove magical effects from a target.

name: Holy Strike
description: A weapon strike infused with holy energy.

name: Purifying Flame
description: Burn away corruption with sacred fire.

name: Spell Breaker
description: Shatter an enemy spell in progress.

name: Null Zone
description: Create a zone where magic cannot function.

name: Reflect Spell
description: Reflect the next spell cast at you.

name: Cleansing Light
description: Remove debuffs and heal with holy light.

name: Righteous Fury
description: Enter a state of holy rage.

name: Shield of Faith
description: Create a holy barrier around yourself.

name: Censure
description: Mark an enemy as a heretic, increasing damage taken.

name: Holy Weapon
description: Imbue your weapon with holy power.

name: Aura of Protection
description: Project an aura that protects allies from magic.

name: Judgment
description: Pass judgment on a foe, dealing holy damage.

name: Sanctuary
description: Create a zone of safety.

name: Inquisition
description: Interrogate with holy power, stunning the target.

name: Banishing Smite
description: Strike that can banish extraplanar beings.

name: Seal Magic
description: Prevent target from casting spells.

name: Divine Intervention
description: Call upon divine aid in desperate times.

name: Final Judgment
description: Execute an enemy with divine authority.
